title: Adaptive Synthetic Data Augmentation Toolkit
summary: A closed-loop ML engine that detects the cohorts a classifier fails on and generates targeted synthetic rows to fix them, retraining and re-evaluating against SMOTE and no-augmentation baselines. It uses SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table) and SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample per-cohort synthetic data as the core augmentation engine.
evidence: generator_utils.py: 'import sdv.single_table as st' and _GENERATORS maps 'copula'/'tvae'/'ctgan' to SDV synthesizer classes, instantiated via getattr(st, ...)(metadata, **params)
